# RSI mean reversion

*Buys oversold RSI with a price limit, sells when RSI recovers.*

**Kind** strategy · **Resolution** 15m

Buys an oversold bounce and sells when RSI recovers.

**Entry.** RSI crosses back up through *Buy below*: it was oversold and is turning. The strategy buys *Size % equity*
with a 1 % price limit. Entry bars are shaded and marked.

**Exit.** RSI crosses above *Exit above*, or the price falls *Stop %* below the average entry price. The stop is
checked at every bar's close in `onCandle`, and on every block in `onBlock` where blocks are delivered (precise, 1B,
live), so it reacts sooner there.

**Plots.** RSI goes to its own pane (`pane: 1`) with the two levels as dashed lines.

**What to try.** Compare a quick and a precise run: the difference is the block-level stop.

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd>, open **Strategies** and choose **RSI mean reversion**. Or copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor and click **Add to chart**.

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RSI length | int | `14` |
| Buy below | float | `30` |
| Exit above | float | `60` |
| Stop % | float | `4` |
| Size % equity | float | `30` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/examples/rsi_mean_reversion.as.js`.

```js
strategy({ name: "RSI mean reversion", version: "0.1", market: "ALPHA:61", resolution: "15m",
           capital: { tao: 100 }, actOn: "confirmed", risk: { maxPriceImpactPct: 0.5, maxPositionTao: 60 } });

const len     = input.int("RSI length", 14, { min: 2, max: 100 });
const buyLvl  = input.float("Buy below", 30, { min: 5, max: 50 });
const exitLvl = input.float("Exit above", 60, { min: 50, max: 95 });
const stopPct = input.float("Stop %", 4, { min: 0.5, max: 30, step: 0.5 });
const sizePct = input.float("Size % equity", 30, { min: 1, max: 100 });

const rsi = ta.rsi(candle.close, len);
const entry = ta.crossover(rsi, buyLvl);
const exit  = ta.crossover(rsi, exitLvl);

plot(rsi, { title: "RSI", color: "#8b98a8", pane: 1 });
hline(buyLvl,  { color: "#2bb889", style: "dashed", pane: 1 });
hline(exitLvl, { color: "#e35c70", style: "dashed", pane: 1 });
plotShape(entry, { shape: "triangleUp", location: "belowBar", color: "#2bb889" });
bgcolor(entry, { color: "rgba(43,184,137,0.10)" });

function stopHit(price = 0) {
  const p = account.position();
  return p.alpha > 0 && price < p.avgPrice * (1 - stopPct / 100);
}

event.onCandle((bar) => {
  const pos = account.position();
  if (pos.alpha === 0 && entry.value) {
    const size = account.equity() * sizePct / 100;
    trade.buy({ tao: size, maxPrice: pool.price() * 1.01, ttlBlocks: 3, reason: "rsi-bounce" });
  } else if (pos.alpha > 0 && (exit.value || stopHit(bar.close))) {
    trade.closePosition({ reason: exit.value ? "rsi-recovered" : "stop" });
  }
});
event.onBlock((b) => { if (stopHit(b.price)) trade.closePosition({ reason: "stop-block" }); });
event.onFill((f) => log(f.side, f.alpha.toFixed(2), "α @", f.price.toFixed(7), `impact ${f.impactBps.toFixed(1)}bps`));
```
